stem:
Right triangle \(UVW\) is similar to right triangle \(KLM\). Vertex \(W\) is at \((0, -2)\). The slopes of the hypotenuses of the two triangles are equal.

Which ordered pair could be the coordinates of vertex \(V\)?
visual_elements: coordinate grid with line through points including a right triangle KLM in quadrant III
notes: Extracted from STAAR 2024 Q36; math notation preserved as in image.
